offers.eligibility: Students. You need the GitHub Student Developer Pack, which comes with 3 months of DataCamp Premium for free.
steps: Sign up for the GitHub Student Developer Pack. GitHub will ask for proof that you're a student.
Inside the pack, claim the DataCamp offer. That gets you 3 months of Premium.
Do the Azure Fundamentals track. It's 4 courses, roughly 8 hours.
DataCamp emails the code, usually within 3 days. If it doesn't show up, ask their support.
offers.summary: If you're a student, finish DataCamp's Azure Fundamentals track and they'll email you a 50% off code for AZ-900.
offers.title: Half-price AZ-900 through DataCamp
offers.validity: The code lasts 3 to 6 months. The email tells you the exact date.

offers.eligibility: Students. You need the GitHub Student Developer Pack, which comes with 3 months of DataCamp Premium for free.
steps: Get the GitHub Student Developer Pack and claim DataCamp Premium from it.
Work through the Data Analyst in Power BI track. Give yourself a few weeks, it's long.
Use the 50% code DataCamp sends you when you book PL-300.
offers.summary: Same deal as the AZ-900 one, but for the Power BI exam. The track is a lot longer, about 48 hours.
offers.title: Half-price PL-300 through DataCamp
offers.validity: The code lasts 3 to 6 months. The email tells you the exact date.
